# ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. Announces Inaugural Stock Repurchase Program


October 14, 2026 4:05pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_11b2d61dcbb25691caa687996098a156/servisfirstbank/news/2026-10-14_ServisFirst_Bancshares_Inc_Announces_Inaugural_268.pdf)


BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc., (NYSE: SFBS) (“ServisFirst”), the holding company for ServisFirst Bank, today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a stock repurchase program, under which ServisFirst may repurchase up to two million shares of its outstanding common stock through December 31, 2027. Repurchases may be made from time to time in the open market at prevailing prices and based on market conditions, or in privately negotiated transactions.


This represents ServisFirst’s inaugural stock repurchase program and reflects the Board’s confidence in ServisFirst’s financial strength, capital position, and long-term growth prospects, and commitment to capital management tools that allow ServisFirst to maximize shareholder value.


**About ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc.**


ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. is a bank holding company based in Birmingham, Alabama. Through its subsidiary ServisFirst Bank, ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. provides business and personal financial services from locations in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North and South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas and Virginia. Through the Bank, we originate commercial, consumer and other loans and accept deposits, provide electronic banking services, such as online and mobile banking, including remote deposit capture, deliver treasury and cash management services and provide correspondent banking services to other financial institutions. ServisFirst Bancshares, Inc. files periodic reports with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
